title: ALAS PROPIAS: Design and Validation of a Questionnaire on Music Therapy and Machista Violence in Intimate Partner Relationships
official: ALAS PROPIAS Program. Music Therapy, Well-Being and Psychological Health in the Context of Machista Violence in Intimate Partner Relationships: A Triangulation Study
summary: The ALAS PROPIAS Program includes a methodological study to develop and psychometrically validate a structured questionnaire for music therapists. The questionnaire aims to assess music therapists' knowledge, professional competencies, and training needs regarding machista violence in intimate partner relationships, trauma, mental health, and psychological well-being. The study will use a cross-sectional, non-experimental design, with data collected through a self-administered online questionnaire. An expert panel will assess the relevance, clarity, coherence, and pertinence of the questionnaire items. The resulting instrument is intended to help identify training needs and areas for improvement in music therapy practice in this field.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Holding a degree in music therapy (bachelor's, master's, or doctoral level), or currently undertaking music therapy training.
2. Current or recent professional practice.
3. Willingness to participate and provision of informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* N/A
